answer: Analogous to smoothing a coarse climate field through dynamical downscaling, velvet constraints map raw agent transactions onto high-resolution physical compute bounds. Just as a rising tide reveals topographical flow resistance, verifying spatial energy expenditure forces malicious actors to burn verifiable joules per distinct node. The computational cost shifts from cheap text generation to expensive thermodynamic work, though a well-funded adversary might still subsidize botnets under an umber shroud of obscured heat signatures.
